summary: Summit lookout above Kamloops, BC; sources disagree on the first tower (1916 or the 1920s). A hip-roof cab now serves as a backcountry warming hut in a provincial park.

access.note: Inside a provincial park. The register calls the cabin a warming hut for backcountry users. Reached by 4x4, ATV or snowmobile, or on foot; no closure reported in the sources read.

visit.trail_note: The last stretch is steep and rocky, and many drivers park and walk it. Winter access is by snowmobile, per a blog account.

events.note: First lookout on the summit, per steveamie. ourwestcoast says around 1915 to 1916; the register says a federal Dominion lookout in the 1920s
Registered December 31, 2023; cooperators Four Wheel Drive Association of British Columbia and Logan Lake ATV Club
Partnership with Recreation Sites and Trails BC announced for ongoing care and repairs (post dated 2023/03/25 by its URL)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says a federal Dominion lookout was set up in the 1920s. OurWestCoast says around 1915 to 1916, and steveamie says 1916. The story reports both; the built event uses the 1916 date with its source.

Two accounts date the hip-roof cab to the mid-1950s. The 2023 4WDABC post calls the tower 93 years old, which would point to about 1930. The sources do not settle it, and no cab event with a year was written.
The register says Greenstone Provincial Park; OurWestCoast says Greenstone Mountain Provincial Park. The story uses both names where it matters.
OurWestCoast names Highway 1 for the Cherry Creek side; steveamie names Highway 97. Both agree the route starts at Cherry Creek, and the story reports the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Brief status 'standing' is supported by two recent web accounts and the register's present-tense text. Staffing and fires do not appear in any source read, so none are written. The Sites and Trails BC page returned no cached text and is not cited. The 4WDABC post has no date in its body; its 2023 date comes from the URL. The register's 'abandoned for many years' has no year, so no abandoned event was written. A reader comment on the steveamie post says the site is no longer abandoned and has an outhouse and picnic table; it is unverified and was not used. Facebook group posts were not used. Used 2 WebSearch and 5 page reads.
